winning_topic_super_catchup_152k_gap.title: The $152k Super Gap at 40: How to Catch Up Before 60

beats.narration: At forty, median super is one-sixty-one thousand, but you need three-thirteen for comfortable retirement.
That's a one-fifty-two thousand dollar gap. And SG twelve percent alone won't close it.
beats.edit: pan right 60px 0.6s only when connected gap

beats.narration: But you have three powerful catch-up tools that most forty-year-olds miss.
First, salary sacrifice. Concessional cap is thirty thousand per year.
Plus you can use unused cap from last five years. That's carry-forward.
Example: Ann earns one hundred thousand, sacrifices thirty thousand, uses twenty thousand carry-forward.
She puts fifty thousand into super, saves eight thousand tax, super grows tax-free.
beats.visual: money bag coins dropping + calculator count-up $50k

beats.narration: Second, transition to retirement. At sixty, start a pension four to ten percent, tax-free.
Work three days, get same pay, super keeps growing. No work test after sixty-five.
Third, downsizer. Sold your house after ten years? Put three hundred thousand each into super.
beats.edit: Lottie Android house SOLD stamp confetti Premium 350ms

beats.narration: No age limit, no work test, ten year ownership, ninety days to act after sale.
beats.visual: calendar 10 years + 90 days + no age limit badge

beats.narration: Combine them: salary sacrifice plus TTR plus downsizer. That's how you close one-fifty-two thousand gap.
beats.visual: combo 3 icons + success checkmark draw particle burst

beats.narration: Turning sixty? You can still catch up. Start today, not tomorrow.
